downstream_payload.text:
小组群里有人说，新来的实习生一进门就“班味很重”。周蔓看了半天，没立刻转发。她不知道这句话是在说疲惫、规矩多，还是只是在拿对方开玩笑。

“别替他下定义，”她说，“先问清楚这词在你们那个群里到底是什么意思。”

However, character dialogue can still be partially reviewed for internal coherence: 周蔓's response is metalinguistic and deliberately refrains from defining the term, which is intentional and self-aware. No text-level language defect is present; the only unresolved issue is the real-world validity of the phrase in the group chat context.
